purpose: Teach: カルロス/奄美/インディアン/南アフリカ/カイロ/ジョニー/日産/西武

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カルロス・ゴーン関連の本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was reading a book about Carlos Ghosn.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Speaking as if sharing a small detail she noticed. Gentle curiosity, no urgency. Warm toward Aoi.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、奄美大島のお土産下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer gave me a souvenir from Amami Ōshima.
lines.style: Warm appreciation in the voice. Slight lift on the gift itself. Pleased but not effusive — genuine pleasure without performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、インディアン伝統の編み物を学ばれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer is learning traditional Indigenous weaving, apparently.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering. Pace slightly slowed by genuine interest. The tone of someone discovering something lovely about a person.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、南アフリカ駐在経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has been stationed in South Africa, she told me.
lines.style: Quiet admiration underneath. Reflective, as if turning this fact over. Appreciative of the breadth of someone's life experience.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カイロのピラミッド訪問されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer went to see the pyramids in Cairo.
lines.style: Gentle wonder in the delivery. Slight pause before 'Cairo' — letting the place settle. Soft, almost reverential about the scale of their travels.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジョニー・デップの映画ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's a Johnny Depp fan, apparently.
lines.style: Light, easy observation. No judgment, just noting something human and particular. Same warm, neutral curiosity as before.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、日産自動車にお勤めだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer works for Nissan, she mentioned.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Cataloging another detail about someone she's come to know. Steady, accepting tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、西武百貨店で買い物されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was shopping at Seibu department store.
lines.style: Gentle, closing thought. Softer attack than before. Almost trailing off — the small, warm accumulation of knowing someone's small habits and corners of their life.
